name: Fitzroy Island Coral Nursery
description: Offshore nurseries where fragments of heat-resilient coral are grown on frames before being replanted on degraded sections of reef. Volunteers with dive certification help maintain the frames and monitor growth.

name: Catchment Water Quality Program
description: Working with landholders along reef catchments to reduce sediment and fertiliser runoff, which smothers coral and fuels algal blooms in inshore waters.

name: Reef Health Citizen Science
description: Training reef visitors and recreational divers to record coral condition, bleaching and marine life sightings, feeding into a broader picture of reef health across the region.

name: Coastal Clean-Up Network
description: Regular volunteer clean-ups removing marine debris from beaches and mangroves before it reaches the reef, with data collected on what's found and where it comes from.
